## LoaderInput type

What `g.loader()` takes: a loader's declaration, typed by the graph's entities, run values and  connectors. README, "Loaders", walks through it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type LoaderInput<N extends string, K, V, C extends Attrs, NeedK extends keyof C, HintK extends keyof C, Ctx, CtxK extends keyof Ctx, Conn extends string> = {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly version?: number;
    readonly keyedBy: N;
    readonly needs?: readonly NeedK[];
    readonly hints?: readonly HintK[];
    readonly ctx?: readonly CtxK[];
    readonly connectors: Connectors<Conn>;
    readonly batch: Batch;
    readonly keep?: (o: Kept) => Retention;
    readonly partial?: "keep" | "drop";
    readonly retry?: Retry;
    readonly load: (refs: readonly Ref<K, Pick<C, NoInfer<NeedK>>, Pick<C, NoInfer<HintK>>>[], ctx: Pick<Ctx, CtxK>, budget: Budget, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<Envelope<K, V>>;
    readonly merge?: {
        readonly needs: (refs: readonly Ref<K, Pick<C, NoInfer<NeedK>>>[]) => Pick<C, NoInfer<NeedK>> | undefined;
        readonly narrow: (value: never, ref: Ref<K, Pick<C, NoInfer<NeedK>>>) => NoInfer<V> | undefined;
        readonly empty: NoInfer<V>;
    };
} & ({
    readonly cost?: undefined;
    readonly price?: undefined;
} | {
    readonly cost: Metered;
    readonly price: (refs: readonly Ref<K, Pick<C, NoInfer<NeedK>>, Pick<C, NoInfer<HintK>>>[], ctx: Pick<Ctx, CtxK>, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<number>;
});
```
